_comment: Every design runs on the same fleet with the same luck. Ablations each turn off one safeguard of the operator.

as_is.name: As-is
as_is.label: As found: a StatefulSet and a backup cron job. Pods restart in order when the previous one is Ready, scale-down deletes the highest pod, snapshots are never tested or copied out of the region

operator.name: Operator
operator.label: The operator: shard-aware rolling restarts, temporary copies for single-copy shards, drain before delete, repair, rebalance, restore-tested backups shipped to the DR region

no_wait_active.name: No wait for Active
no_wait_active.label: Restart the next node when pods are Ready, not when replicas are Active

no_drain.name: No drain
no_drain.label: Delete nodes without moving their replicas first

no_surge.name: No surge copy
no_surge.label: No temporary copy before restarting the only copy of a shard

no_verify.name: No restore drill
no_verify.label: Ship backups without a restore drill

no_ship.name: No shipping
no_ship.label: Backups stay in the cluster's region
